errors.text: The proposed oxidation-driven tribolayer mechanism is incompatible with the target atomistic nanoindentation/friction system, which does not specify air, reactive chemistry, or oxide formation.
The hypothesis replaces the FeNiCrCoCu/Cu nanoscale FCC system with unrelated coating compositions, substrates, and macroscopic sliding tests.

It predicts an initial decrease in friction and a U-shaped wear trend, whereas the target shows friction increasing with temperature and wear resistance remaining approximately stable through 600 K before sharply degrading near 900 K.
The proposed 450–500 °C degradation boundary does not reconstruct the target threshold of approximately 900 K (627 °C).
